players.name: Kirill Kaprizov
players.inj_detail: Kaprizov left Thursday's (Oct. 15) win over St. Louis in the third period after a hit from Blues goalie Joel Hofer drove him into the boards. Coach John Hynes said he is OK and the concern level is low, with his status worth watching before Sunday's game against Columbus.

players.name: Wyatt Johnston
players.inj_detail: Johnston has missed games with an illness since Oct. 13. The Stars are hoping to have him back for Saturday's (Oct. 17) game against Chicago.

players.name: Jake Sanderson
players.inj_detail: Sanderson re-injured his lower body in the season opener in Toronto on Oct. 3 and has not played since. He was out again Thursday (Oct. 15) against the Islanders and is still listed day-to-day.

players.name: John Tavares
players.inj_detail: Tavares left Thursday's (Oct. 15) game against Buffalo with a lower-body injury and did not return.

players.name: Ryan Nugent-Hopkins
players.inj_detail: Nugent-Hopkins has a lower-body injury from late September and is on injured reserve. The Oilers said on Oct. 15 that he has been skating with his teammates.

players.name: Pierre-Luc Dubois
players.inj_detail: Dubois has been ill and did not play in the Oct. 14 game against Montreal.

players.name: Pavel Buchnevich
players.inj_detail: Buchnevich was out for Thursday's (Oct. 15) game against Minnesota for personal reasons.

players.name: Zach Hyman
players.inj_detail: Hyman has an undisclosed injury from Oct. 1 that kept him out of the Oct. 15 game against Utah. He was back in the lineup on Saturday (Oct. 17) and scored in a 6-2 win in Utah.

players.name: Jamie Benn
Mathew Barzal
players.inj_detail: Barzal has a knee injury from mid-September. The Islanders said on Oct. 12 that he has been skating on his own, with no timeline for a return.

players.name: Mikael Granlund
players.inj_detail: The Ducks said on Thursday (Oct. 15) that Granlund is day-to-day with an upper-body injury.

players.name: Bowen Byram
players.inj_detail: Byram is listed with an upper-body injury from Oct. 15 and was out for Thursday's game against Winnipeg.

players.name: Ivan Demidov
players.inj_detail: Demidov hurt his lower body on Oct. 3 and was placed on injured reserve on Oct. 6. No timeline has been given.

players.name: William Eklund
players.inj_detail: Eklund hurt his ankle on Oct. 8. The Senators said on Oct. 15 that he is expected to miss the next 10 to 12 weeks.

players.name: Taylor Hall
players.inj_detail: Hall left the Oct. 13 game against Washington with an upper-body injury and did not return.

players.name: Cutter Gauthier
players.inj_detail: Gauthier has been listed with an upper-body injury since Oct. 10. He was a full participant in practice on Thursday (Oct. 15).

players.name: Luke Evangelista
players.inj_detail: Evangelista has been ill since Oct. 13 and was out for Thursday's (Oct. 15) game against the Rangers.

players.name: Rasmus Dahlin
players.inj_detail: Dahlin has an upper-body injury from Oct. 12 and was out for Thursday's (Oct. 15) game against Toronto.

players.name: Travis Konecny
players.inj_detail: Konecny was placed on injured reserve with a lower-body injury from Oct. 10.

players.name: Mats Zuccarello
players.inj_detail: The Kings placed Zuccarello on injured reserve on Oct. 10 with an undisclosed injury.

players.name: Josh Morrissey
players.inj_detail: Morrissey has had an upper-body injury since Oct. 7. The Jets said on Thursday (Oct. 15) that he has been downgraded to week-to-week.

recap.text: Chugalugs91 still lead the real standings with 76 points, ahead of Debits & Checks (59) and Peter Will Probably Pick Old Guys (58). Sebastian Aho just set a pool record with a point in six straight games. The projections still have Chugalugs91 finishing last, with a 0.1% title chance.
recap.impact: No threat to you. They lead you by 47 points today, but you're projected to finish about 99 points ahead of them.

recap.text: The title race is a three-way dead heat. Dom Scavuzzo jumped from 4th to 1st projected, with odds up from 11% to 18%. 97 Problems slipped to 2nd at 17%, and Lord of the Rinks sits 3rd at 17%. Debits & Checks are next at 9%.
recap.impact: You're right in it: about 6 projected points separate you from 1st, and the gap to 4th is about 15 points.

recap.text: Biggest movers: PhilCap fell from 3rd to 5th projected (9% to 8%) with Ivan Demidov and William Eklund both on injured reserve. Anthony Scavuzzo dropped from 11th to 14th after Travis Konecny and Mats Zuccarello went on injured reserve. In the real standings, Debits & Checks climbed from 9th to 2nd and RDR slid from 3rd to 10th.
recap.impact: Good for you. PhilCap was one of the teams projected just behind you a week ago, and now sits about 16 points back.

recap.text: Top pool scorers this week: Auston Matthews 9 points (Girl on the Lake), William Nylander 8 (Debits & Checks), and Alexis Lafreniere, Tim Stutzle and Sebastian Aho with 7 each. Dom Scavuzzo got 6 apiece from Brandon Hagel and Nikita Kucherov.
recap.impact: Hagel and Kucherov are the ones that hurt: they powered the team that just passed you. Kaprizov's 5 points led your roster.

recap.text: Role changes on your roster: Anton Frondell dropped from Chicago's top power-play unit to the second, Porter Martone moved up to Philadelphia's second line but back to the second power-play unit, and Brady Tkachuk moved onto Florida's top line. Sam Reinhart is centring Florida's second line with Aleksander Barkov out 6 to 8 weeks.
recap.impact: Small knocks for Frondell and Reinhart, who were already projected for modest totals. Martone's bigger even-strength role is a mild plus.

recap.text: Injuries: Jake Sanderson is still day-to-day with a lower-body injury and has played one game. Travis Konecny and Mats Zuccarello joined the injured reserve list, and Connor Bedard, Ryan Nugent-Hopkins and Mathew Barzal remain out.
recap.impact: Sanderson is the one to watch for you: he has one game played, and every game he misses is one fewer from your defence.

lens.headline: Kaprizov's hat trick kept you in a three-way race, now 3rd projected.
bullets: You're 16th in the real standings with 29 points, but projected to finish 3rd with about 737, and your roster still projects 1st in the pool from here on.
Win odds slipped from 18.7% to 17.1% since last week's recap, and top-3 odds from 40% to 39%, as Dom Scavuzzo jumped past you from 4th to 1st projected.
The projected gap to 1st is about 6 points (737 to 743). Closing it comes down to your cold shooters: Wyatt Johnston, Sam Reinhart and Brady Tkachuk have 35 shots between them and no goals.

Kaprizov drove the week with 5 points, including a hat trick against Florida, and Dylan Holloway had a three-assist night. Kaprizov's 6 goals on 13 shots are running hot, while Frondell lost his top power-play spot and Reinhart is centring a line without Barkov.
Next week, watch Sanderson's return from his lower-body injury, whether Johnston and Reinhart finally score, and Dom Scavuzzo's Hagel and Kucherov, who had 6 points each this week.

items.body: Eight straight games with a point, a new pool record. Quinn Hughes' run of seven for Matthew's Team is history.

items.headline: McDavid goes five-for in Utah
items.body: Two goals and three assists in a 6-2 Edmonton win. 97 Problems climb from 8th to 6th in the real standings.

items.headline: The Rinks seize the projected throne
items.body: Title odds jump from 18% to 22% as Lord of the Rinks go from 3rd to 1st in the projections.

items.headline: Rough night for Dom Scavuzzo
items.body: Title odds dip from 16% to 13%, and Dom Scavuzzo slip from 2nd to 4th in the projections.
